name: Betty's Better Butters
improvements: Add a shelf-level footnote below the butter rounds, mirroring Douglas & Cromie's forecourt foot, so the placeholder disclosure survives if a visitor scans the grid without reading the banner.
Retitle the shelf section for assistive tech — e.g. aria-label="Illustrative range placeholders" — so screen-reader users hear the proposal before each flavour name.
summary: Betty's Better Butters passes all four publication checks. The concept correctly treats the live site's missing product shelf as the gap, and every invented flavour is disclosed three ways: the Mourne Made banner, a callout that the current site lists no products, and a per-jar "placeholder flavour" badge. Founder-story and delivery claims match the 24 July verification of Dundrum Butters Ltd.; nav and shop links are inert placeholders. No concept-specific edits were required.
verificationNote: Dundrum Butters Ltd. trades as Betty's Better Butters; verified open 24 July 2026 with a live two-page ProSite site that publishes no product names, sizes or prices.
